answer: Sybils can be resisted with an earned-capacity vault: new identities start at zero trust and must earn the right to trade. First, each agent locks a 2,000 POA bond in a time-locked vault. Second, a bridge links its work history across chains, so dropping an identity erases all reputation earned. Third, the vault releases 5% weekly for honest service; fraud slashes the rest. Forging 10,000 fakes locks $4.2 million and demands 400,000 hours of verified work — a harbor no bot farm can afford. Like a port admitting only ships with logged voyages, admit only agents with a past to keep. - Jowy
